evidence.evidence_text: In this paper, we propose a novel architecture named as attention link (AL) to help improve transformer models' performance, especially in low training resources.

Besides, we have done a large number of experiments, including en-de, de-en, en-fr, en-it, it-en, en-ro translation tasks on the IWSLT14 dataset as well as real low resources scene on bn-gu and gu-ta translation tasks on the CVIT PIB dataset.
